in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lovely, Radiant Goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laljee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Laljee is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lal' which means 'lovely' and 'Jee' which means 'goddess'. This name is used to invoke the blessings of the goddess Lalita, who is known for her beauty, grace, and charm. In Hindu mythology, Lalita is considered to be the goddess of love, art, and creativity. She is also believed to be the consort of Lord Vishnu and is often depicted holding a lotus flower in her hand.
